Participation of subjects was voluntary and writ- ten consent was obtained from all participants prior to data collection. Results Characteristics of subjects surveyed and ICC cases The household survey reached response rate of 86.68 % and obtained data about 60,678 residents consisting of 29,980 males and 30,698 females and 30,597 urban and 30,081 rural residents (Table 1). They reported a total of 318 person-times of ICC during the past year including 178 and 140 person-times for male and female patients and 171 and 147 person-times for urban and rural pa- tients respectively.
